issues.description: Script uses GM_xmlhttpRequest to send requests to api.torn.com and twse.dev. The API key is user-provided and stored in localStorage, then sent to api.torn.com for game data. Requests to twse.dev may include faction IDs and hospital times, but do not appear to transmit sensitive user data or cookies.
issues.location: GM_xmlhttpRequest calls (not fully shown in provided code, but implied by @connect and config usage)
issues.recommendation: Ensure only necessary data is sent, avoid transmitting cookies or sensitive information. Document transmitted fields for transparency.

issues.description: Script reads and writes to localStorage for storing API keys and configuration. No evidence of document.cookie, sessionStorage, or IndexedDB usage. No keylogger or clipboard access.
issues.recommendation: Do not store sensitive keys in localStorage if possible. Consider encrypting API keys or using GM_setValue for better isolation.

issues.description: Script grants unsafeWindow, which exposes script context to the page and vice versa. This can be abused if the page is compromised.
issues.recommendation: Remove unsafeWindow unless strictly necessary. Use GM_* APIs for communication instead.

issues.description: Script requests GM_xmlhttpRequest, GM_addStyle, GM_registerMenuCommand, unsafeWindow. GM_xmlhttpRequest and unsafeWindow are high-risk if not used carefully.
issues.recommendation: Review necessity of each permission. Remove unused or high-risk grants.

issues.description: Script loads no external libraries via @require. All code is inline. No supply chain risk detected.
issues.recommendation: If using @require in future, always pin versions and use official CDNs.

summary: Script transmits user API key and faction data to api.torn.com and twse.dev, stores API key in localStorage, and grants unsafeWindow. No evidence of DOM XSS, code injection, or obfuscation. Supply chain risk is low. Main risks are data transmission and privacy collection. Remove unsafeWindow and improve API key storage for better security.
